Sunday's your night off — so hand it over to Azúcar. 🍹👑 Industry Night Drag Show is coming for the service and beauty crew who spent the week making everyone else look and feel good. Now it's your turn. Rohla Blunt and Abele Fantasy host a night built for YOU, complete with specials just for industry folks and a Best "Karen" Impression Contest that's about to get unhinged in the best way. 😂 Flip your name tag off, walk in with your industry ID, and get treated like the star you already are. This is the release your week has been begging for — heels off, drinks up, drag show ON. Don't sleep on this one, mark it, tell your coworkers, bring the whole team. Every body welcome, every industry represented. 💃🔥

📅 Sunday, September 27 | Doors 8PM / Show 9PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $15 online / $20 at door

Lights down, lashes on, and the smell of tequila already in the air. 💄🍸 Picture this: the Main Floor glowing, Rohla Blunt and Abele Fantasy commanding every inch of that stage, and a room full of industry folks finally getting to be the ones served for a change. The energy hits different on Industry Night — part release, part chaos, all glam. Somewhere between the drink specials and the drag numbers, the Best "Karen" Impression Contest breaks out and the whole place loses it. 😂 You can feel the bass in your chest, the glitter in the air, the kind of night that turns strangers into your new favorite people. This is what Sunday nights are supposed to feel like. 🔥👑

Mark your calendar — Industry Night Drag Show hits Azúcar this Sunday, September 27. 📌🍹 Doors open at 8PM, show starts at 9PM, hosted by Rohla Blunt and Abele Fantasy. Bring your industry ID for special pricing made just for service and beauty folks, and stick around for the Best "Karen" Impression Contest — trust, it's chaos in the best way. 😂 Tickets are $15 online, $20 at the door, so grab yours ahead of time and skip the line. This is the one night a week built for the people who spend every other night taking care of everyone else. Come treat yourself. 👑💥
